name: 原创全真卷 03（成果盘点 · 略难）
note: 结构与真考一致：7 部分 32 题，Q1-30 各 1 分，Q31/Q32 各 15 分，原始分 60，限时 60 分钟。

items.text:
LIFT NOT WORKING
Please use the stairs next to the café. We are sorry — it will be ready by Friday.
options: The café is closed until Friday.
People must take the stairs for now.
The stairs are next to the lift.
items.explain: 电梯坏了，暂时走咖啡馆旁边的楼梯。

items.text: Team! Saturday's match starts at 9, not 10. The bus leaves school at 8. Don't forget your water bottle — it will be hot. Coach Lee
items.q: What time should players be at school?
items.explain: 大巴 8 点从学校出发，所以 8 点前要到校。

items.text:
QUIET ROOM
For reading only.
Please take phone calls outside and leave bags at the front desk.
items.q: What can you do in this room?
items.explain: For reading only；打电话去外面，包存前台。

items.text: Mia, your cousin's plane lands at 5, so we'll be at your house about 6.30. Could you tell your mum not to cook — we're bringing dinner! Aunt Jo
items.q: Why did Aunt Jo write to Mia?
options: To ask Mia's mum to cook dinner.
To say they will arrive about 6.30.
To ask Mia to meet the plane.
items.explain: 核心信息是到达时间约 6:30，且晚饭他们带。

items.text:
SWIMMERS
Shower before you enter the pool.
Lessons finish 10 minutes early today for pool cleaning.
items.explain: finish 10 minutes early = 提前 10 分钟结束。

items.text: Class 6: Bring your recorder AND music book on Thursday. Students without both cannot join the practice for next month's concert.
items.q: What happens if you forget your music book?
options: You cannot take part in the practice.
You must buy a new one.
You can share with a friend.
items.explain: without both cannot join —— 两样缺一不可。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: Science Stars
profiles.text: We meet on Tuesdays in Room 12. Every month we do a big experiment — last time we made a small volcano! New members should ask Mr Chen first. Bring an old shirt because things get dirty.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Book Friends
profiles.text: We read one book each month and talk about it on Friday afternoons in the library. Juice and biscuits are free. This term we are reading stories from different countries. Everyone is welcome — just come!

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Young Cooks
profiles.text: We cook a new dish every Wednesday. You pay two pounds each week for the food, and you take home what you make! Places are only for ten students, so put your name on the list early.

questions.q: Which club costs money every week?
Which club gives free food and drink?
Which club has only a small number of places?
For which club should you speak to a teacher before joining?
Which club tells you to wear old clothes?
questions.explain: Bring an old shirt because things get dirty。

questions.q: Which club meets at the end of the school week?
In which club can you take something home?

part3.title: The Best Mistake
part3.passage:
Rosa loved painting, but she never showed her pictures to anyone. She thought they were not good enough. One rainy Tuesday, she left her painting of the sea on the school bus by mistake.
The next morning, the bus driver, Mr Ford, put the painting on the wall of the bus with a note: "Whose beautiful sea is this?" All week, children asked about it. Some said it looked like a real photo. Rosa was too shy to say anything.
On Friday, her best friend Nina saw Rosa's paint box and understood everything. "You must tell them," Nina said, "or I will!" So Rosa stood up on the bus and said quietly, "It's mine." Everyone clapped.
Now Rosa's paintings hang in the school hall, and she is making a new one — a picture of a yellow school bus.

questions.q: Why did Rosa keep her paintings secret?
options: She thought they were not good enough.
Her friends did not like art.
She had no place to show them.
questions.explain: she thought they were not good enough。

questions.q: How did the painting get on the bus wall?
questions.explain: Mr Ford put the painting on the wall。

questions.q: What did some children think about the painting?
How did Nina know the painting was Rosa's?
questions.explain: saw Rosa's paint box and understood。

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A girl who learns to share her art.
questions.explain: 主旨：罗莎从不敢展示到全校展出。

part4.title: Sleep
part4.passage: Everyone needs sleep, but children need more than adults. When you sleep, your body (1) ___ and your brain puts the day's new information away, like books on a (2) ___. Children of eleven should sleep about ten hours every (3) ___. It is hard to fall asleep if you (4) ___ computer games late at night, because your brain stays busy. A warm shower, a dark room and a good book (5) ___ much better. If you sleep well, you will (6) ___ new things faster the next day.

gaps.explain: 每晚约 10 小时 → every night。
这些办法更有效 → work much better。
睡得好学得快 → learn faster。

part5.passage:
Dear Grandpa,
I have exciting news! Our orchestra is going to play (1) ___ the city concert hall next month. We practised hard (2) ___ three months, and last week our teacher chose me to sit in the first row! Mum says she (3) ___ buy me a new white shirt for the big night. There will be more (4) ___ five hundred people there. Are you free (5) ___ the fifteenth of May? I really hope you can come and listen (6) ___ us play.
With love, Siyu

gaps.explain: play at the concert hall（in 也通）。
for three months 练了三个月。

gaps.shape: 说的是将要发生的事 → will
gaps.explain: she will buy me… 将来时。
more than five hundred 超过五百。
on the fifteenth of May 具体某天。

p6.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Ruby.

My family is going away next weekend and my cat needs help! Can you feed her on Saturday and Sunday? What time can you come? Do you want anything for helping?
Ruby
points: 要不要报酬(或想要什么感谢)
